dogecoin.text:
Elon Musk using Dogecoin to finance his rocket was a stroke of genius. 

Unlike typical loans than need to be repaid, this is free money for Musk.

As the scam is understood, expect $Doge to fall back under 10 cents.

Every Elon Musk pump of $DOGE sees the crypto rally less and less.
Anyone and everyone wanting in on the "easy money" entered long ago. 
They are likely selling into rallies now.

Smart money knows that 70 cents was likely the high and getting 50 or 55 cents is likely a gift.
